column1: # Cases in which a vendor answers otherwise than the specification, in a pair
# with ZeroDDS, while ZeroDDS follows the clause with its default (the
# maintainer decided to keep the default, 2026-11-01). Unlike
# vendor-self-failures.tsv the case runs, and it must fail with the codes given
# here; omg_suite.py then counts it as a declared deviation, neither passed nor
# red. A declared case that passes, or fails with other codes, is red: the
# list has gone stale, or something else broke.
# codes: what the harness records as produced, per entity.
# harness (optional): the harness arguments the row holds for, e.g. `-x 1`;
